description: This file defines API endpoints for managing Grafana alert rules using the FastAPI framework. It sets up routes for listing, retrieving, creating, updating, and deleting alerts, leveraging a GrafanaClient for API communication.

methods.name: GrafanaClient _client()
methods.description: Creates and returns an instance of GrafanaClient used for API communication.

methods.name: list_alerts(_: str = Depends(get_bearer_token))
methods.description: Handles GET requests to list all alerts.

methods.name: get_alert(id: int = Path(..., description="Alert rule ID"), _: str = Depends(get_bearer_token))
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve a specific alert by ID.

methods.name: create_alert(payload: AlertCreate, _: str = Depends(get_bearer_token))
methods.description: Handles POST requests to create a new alert.

methods.name: update_alert(id: int, payload: AlertUpdate, _: str = Depends(get_bearer_token))
methods.description: Handles PUT requests to update an existing alert by ID.

methods.name: delete_alert(id: int, _: str = Depends(get_bearer_token))
methods.description: Handles DELETE requests to delete an alert by ID.
